    FAQs

    What can I get with Singtel broadband?
    Open

    With Singtel broadband, you can choose all-in Wifi 7 fibre plans from 5Gbps and 10Gbps for a secure and fuss-free network. Add advanced home options and bundle services such as Broadband Protect and Parental Control Pass. It’s designed to help you surf, stream, play and connect with confidence at home.

    Why should I choose Singtel broadband for my home?
    Open

    Singtel broadband offers more than just speed, it delivers a reliable, secure, and fully bundled home connectivity experience, designed to keep up with modern digital lifestyles. Choose Singtel broadband if you want fast fibre speeds, advanced WiFi for busy homes, and added security for your family. Depending on your plan, you can get speeds up to 10Gbps, WiFi 7-ready routers, and WiFi devices with Level 4 certification under Singapore’s Cybersecurity Labelling Scheme. Singtel operates end-to-end WiFi management that works quietly behind the scenes to keep your connection running smoothly, and if anything goes wrong, our 24/7 support team is always ready to help. 

     

    Is Singtel broadband secure for my family?
    Open

    Yes. Singtel’s broadband routers have achieved Level 4 Certification under Singapore’s Cybersecurity Labelling Scheme, and include security features such as password randomisation and automatic firmware updates.

    What is EcoWiFi?
    Open

    EcoWiFi is a feature included with Singtel’s WiFi 7 routers that supports a smarter, more energy-conscious home WiFi setup. It allows you to pause and power down your more energy-consuming WiFi bands when you are resting or not at home. You can access and manually manage it or set an automatic schedule through the My Singtel app.

    Do I get WiFi 7 with Singtel broadband?
    Open

    Yes, on selected Singtel fibre broadband plans. Singtel’s WiFi 7 routers are designed for faster, lower-latency home connectivity, and older devices can still connect because the routers are backward compatible.

    Will my older devices still work with a WiFi 7 router?
    Open

    Yes. Singtel’s WiFi 7 routers are backward compatible, so older phones, laptops, smart TVs and smart home devices can still connect. Your WiFi 7 devices will enjoy the full benefits, while older devices will connect at the highest speed they support.

    Can I add extra services to my broadband plan?
    Open

    Yes. You can add security, productivity and lifestyle services such as Security Suite Plus, Parental Control Pass, Broadband Protect or Broadband Protect Plus, NordVPN Ultimate and Spotify Premium. Selected add-ons also come with waived registration fees when you sign up online.

    How can I protect all my devices on home WiFi?
    Open

    Broadband Protect or Broadband Protect Plus will help safeguard you and your home network. Both work at the network level, so every device on your home WiFi is covered automatically with no extra setup. Broadband Protect helps block malicious websites, while Broadband Protect Plus includes more advanced protection and parental control features. All Singtel Broadband plans come with Broadband protect or upgrade to Broadband Protect Plus for added security features. 

    Do I need to be home for broadband installation?
    Open

    Yes, you may need to be home for two parts of the setup: a NetLink Trust visit if cabling or wiring work is needed, and a Singtel installation visit to set up and test your connection. Singtel and NLT will advise you on the appointments required for your home, and reach out prior the appointment for confirmation.
